choices.content: The shapes you see may be different
The views from all three directions must be the same
You can only see the top

question.prompt:
What happens when you view a simple object from the front, the side, and above?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_p152_q1_question_en.svg)

solutions.explanation: The front and side views are triangles, and the top view is a circle. These views have different shapes, so the shapes you see may be different. The answer is A.
solutions.title: Compare the views
